dataset.name: Corrected version of the DARPA OpTC dataset

detector.configuration: config/kairos.yml with the published tuned OpTC host overrides
detector.baseline_gate: Each primary case must detect at least one node from its frozen corrected ground truth before loss; otherwise stop before the loss comparison.
detector.case_detection_rule: A case is detected when at least one node in its frozen corrected ground truth has a node anomaly score strictly above the frozen validation threshold.
detector.state_policy: Restore the same trained checkpoint and initial inference state for every no-loss and loss replay.
detector.per_host_models: One checkpoint and one validation threshold per attack host; frozen within a case, not shared across cases.

metrics.hypothesis: A-v2: contiguous loss makes detection outcomes less predictable across seeds than uniform random loss at the same deletion count. A-v1 (larger mean drop) is co-registered and reported from the same runs.
metrics.severe_seed_rule: A seed counts as severe when its label node recall is below 0.5 x the no-loss baseline recall. The 0.5 factor is arbitrary and fixed before results.
metrics.spread_comparison: Report standard deviations, their ratio, ranges and per-seed distributions. No F-test: the 30 seeds are repeats on one attack input, not independent samples.
metrics.co_primary_denominator: Label node count fixed on the complete no-loss corrected input; nodes removed by loss count as undetected.
metrics.saturation_rule: If baseline and both loss patterns give a case detection rate of 1.0 for every case at the primary rate, report the case detection rate as saturated and draw the conclusion from label node recall.
metrics.disagreement_rule: If the two metrics point in opposite directions, report both and withhold judgement.

loss_conditions.deletion_scope: Positions inside the per-case evaluation window only, from scripts/window_positions.py; both patterns delete the same count from the same window.
loss_conditions.variant_retention: Variant inputs are not kept. Keep the mask, the application manifest and the run record; regenerate a variant from them when needed.

reduction_rule.note: Fixed before results. Apply in order only when the measured runtime exceeds the available budget, never based on which condition looks favourable.
reduction_rule.floor: Three cases, two loss patterns and the no-loss baseline are retained in every step. If any of those must be dropped, the hypothesis is not reported as tested.
